name: Vitreous-Bajada
description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against a subterranean ocean, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in exotic matter and medicinal compounds and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
